messages:
sam (ceo): Quick AH follow-up: we had a pattern in Q1 losses around pilot acceptance criteria and speed. Can we summarize and own actions?

anya (product): Noted. Customers repeatedly asked for: clear acceptance criteria in SOW, a fast pilot path, and a simple eval snapshot showing model/regression risk.

ben (solutions): From GTM: reps need a short "pilot SLA" clause + a one-paragraph SOW template they can paste into contracts. Right now legal review adds too much latency.

zara (optimize): Could help with a one-click quantization estimator widget (webpage) showing cost vs quality tradeoffs for common models. Sales/demo folks could use this in calls.

noah (legal): We can create a templated SOW and a standard pilot acceptance clause. Legal will fast-track a 'pilot SOW' template for non-enterprise deals. Need a clear owner and example acceptance tests.

eli (cs): CS will draft the acceptance tests checklist (functional + perf). Suggest: 1) inference throughput at X TPS, 2) 95p latency < Y ms, 3) sample-generation QA checks. I'll pair with Product on thresholds.

maya (eng-infra): For fast pilots we can publish a 'pilot kit' that includes: prebuilt image, Terraform module, sample perf job, and a `run_pilot.sh` script. Minimal MVP in 7 business days if we scope narrow.

anya (product): Action list proposal: Product -> per-tenant eval snapshot (canary) in 2 sprints; CS -> acceptance checklist in 5 days; Eng-Infra -> pilot kit in 7 days; Legal -> SOW template in 4 days; Optimize -> estimator mock in 10 days. Agree?

sam (ceo): Agree on owners. Prioritize things Sales can share today (SOW snippet + elevator bullets).

ben (solutions): I'll draft the 3-bullet elevator script and a 30s pitch for pilots. Will post in #sales-playbooks by EOD.

zara (optimize): I'll build a thin mock of the quantization estimator (static page) and share a link for demos. No infra required for MVP.

noah (legal): I'll push an internal review slot for the SOW template. If Product supplies acceptance tests, Legal can sign off within 48 hours.

eli (cs): Adding the checklist to the shared drive and pinging #customer-success when done. Will include example pass/fail cases.

maya (eng-infra): Will open a repo `pilot-kit` with the image + Terraform + `run_pilot.sh`. ETA: 7 days for initial PR.

ops-bot: Calendar invite created: "Pilot Playbooks & SOW review"  Thu 09:00  30m  Attendees: Sam, Anya, Ben, Zara, Noah, Eli, Maya.

anya (product): Good. One extra ask from AH: can we add a short "why we win" box for Sales (3 lines) that highlights observability, model fallback policy, and predictable unit economics? Keep it pithy.

sam (ceo): Yes. Product owns the copy. Ship a draft before the sync.

ben (solutions): I'll also collect 3 recent customer quotes about pilots so we have real language.

anya (product): Thanks all. We'll capture these as concrete tasks in the follow-up and track progress in the playbooks repo. If blockers show up, flag them here so we can escalate.

ops-bot: Thread archived by ops-bot.
